title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone / hosted-global / hosted-per-page
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision <timestamp>: Error: Timed out after ~260-300s waiting for Blazor page/WASM root session (or pwa-msedge child session) to become interactive/attach. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: All three failing Blazor browser-debugger E2E tests time out (~260-300s) waiting for the Blazor WASM root debug session to attach on Windows. The PR only changes Azure environment icon code and its tests, which is unrelated to the VS Code extension's Blazor WASM debugger E2E tests. This is a long-standing recurring flaky pattern for this specific test suite/job with many prior occurrences.
